hook: Your creative work might be powering AI models without your permission.

sections.voiceover: Your creative work might be powering AI models without your permission.
Are creative unions stopping OpenAI from training models on copyrighted works without paying the creators?
But OpenAI CEO Sam Altman admitted to the British House of Lords that models need copyrighted material.
Unions are urging a federal judge to reject a fair use exemption for AI training. SAG-AFTRA and other unions filed a 34-page amicus brief against OpenAI on October 29, 2026.
These groups are challenging OpenAI in federal court to stop the use of unlicensed works.
